name: owned-profile-bootstrap
goal: Profile project source when the adapter and forwarded schema are inside that same project

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Main relocates the unit schema behind its public forwarding entry. The preload only bypasses that old entry and may recursively await its own adapter while loading the real schema.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Normal lifecycle fixtures put the profiling adapter outside their selected project root. Add the missing own-project case using the real forwarded schema, actual route operation and retained runtime observations.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Sealed red 21db0e67 at 57e69da72 records the real own-project loader timing out after 30 seconds at the bootstrap completion assertion.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: 1f3fcf1bf bypasses the relocated schema and its public forwarding entry during bootstrap. All other source observation boundaries remain enforced.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Paired green 9bf8bce7 at 1f3fcf1bf passes the identical frozen test with actual route timing and memory observations. All six normal lifecycle cases also pass.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
